str_all_a_change_goes_to_every_help: All: a change goes to every location except Test / Playback.
str_all_files_will_be_removed_for_help: All files will be removed for good ({n} files):
str_all_the_picture_goes_to_every_help: All: the picture goes to every location except Test / Playback.

str_asking_the_stations_model_about_help: Asking the station's model about this clip…
str_back_to_the_stations_help: Back to the station's sonogram settings

str_direct_sharing_needs_https_use_help: Direct sharing needs https: use WhatsApp (text) or download the audio and the picture to attach them.
str_every_species_of_this_list_has_help: Every species of this list has an answer.

str_log_in_first_to_review_detections: Log in first to review detections.

str_no_picture_saved_yet_upload_one: No picture saved yet: upload one.
str_none_of_its_detections_reviewed_yet: None of its detections reviewed yet
str_none_use_the_models_species_help: None: use the model's species distribution

str_not_an_image_jpeg_png_or_webp_help: Not an image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 6 MB)
str_not_confirmed_and_answered_help: Not confirmed and answered Review later

str_preparing_the_audio_and_the_picture: Preparing the audio and the picture…

str_recording_length_in_force_when_help: Recording length in force when it was detected
str_refused_the_request_came_from_help: Refused: the request came from another web site
str_restore_puts_a_detection_back_help: Restore puts a detection back exactly where it was.

str_still_to_review_and_its_help: Still to review, and its probability of occurrence at the location this week is below the minimum
str_that_was_closing_help: That was the last detection of this list, closing…

str_the_group_the_species_belongs_help: The group the species belongs to (the legend above)

str_this_browser_shares_only_the_help: This browser shares only the text: download the audio to attach it.

str_this_file_is_excluded_from_help: This file is excluded from being purged.
str_this_file_will_be_deleted_when_help: This file will be deleted when disk space needs to be freed.
str_this_recording_is_not_on_the_help: This recording is not on the station any more.
str_ticked_in_the_exclude_list_no_help: Ticked = in the exclude list: no longer detected
str_use_the_review_button_on_any_help: Use the Review button on any detection.

str_you_must_change_the_protection_help: You must be authenticated to change the protection of files.
str_you_must_delete_files_help: You must be authenticated to delete files.
str_you_must_restore_detections_help: You must be authenticated to restore detections.
str_you_must_review_detections_help: You must be authenticated to review detections.
